title: Prometheus Alertmanager
description: Alertmanager webhook v4 through the built-in alertmanager format: one record per alert, externalId {receiver}:{fingerprint}. A resolved alert becomes a new version with status=resolved and validUntil = endsAt + 1 h (a tombstone only with tombstoneOnResolve).

params.name: tombstoneOnResolve
params.description: End the record (tombstone) when the alert resolves instead of keeping a resolved version

params.name: lon
params.description: Station longitude (WGS84); rounded to 0.01° unless exactLocation

params.name: lat
params.description: Station latitude (WGS84); rounded to 0.01° unless exactLocation

setup.instructions:
In `alertmanager.yml`:

```yaml
receivers:
  - name: foresignal
    webhook_configs:
      - url: {url}
        send_resolved: true
        http_config:
          authorization:
            type: Bearer
            credentials: {key}
```
